name: Berlin techno / Basic Channel dub-techno
lineage: Early-1990s Berlin techno subgenre developed by Moritz von Oswald and Mark Ernestus through Basic Channel (1993-onward, parallel labels Maurizio, Chain Reaction, Burial Mix). Characterized by dense Jamaican-dub-influenced delay-and-reverb processing, gradual-evolving texture (often single tracks 8-20 minutes), heavy bass-emphasis, and minimal-yet-immersive arrangement. The genre anchored the canonical 1990s Berlin underground-techno aesthetic and influenced subsequent minimal techno and ambient-techno scenes.
